fact: Regulation 04/18/CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC (payment services) requires a permanent complaints mechanism with a stated handling time (art. 44) and Regulation 01/20/CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC on consumer protection also applies to payment institutions, with complaint services and mediation; the article found no rule on loss sharing in social-engineering fraud.
title: Fraude Mobile Money au Cameroun : pourquoi la sensibilisation ne suffira pas
